'''Scav Crew 1''' was a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of [[Scavenger/Legends|scavengers]] operating on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Second Battle of Coruscant]]. Comprised of twelve individuals, they were armed with [[Heavy blaster pistol/Legends|heavy blaster pistols]]. One scavenger was responsible for handling a group of [[Nek/Legends|neks]], while another was armed with several [[Grenade/Legends|grenades]].
